why: Played as a chip a Soul charged is used with its bonus, twins of one place (BN4: its chip use asks the charged bonus 0x0800C47A, BN4_CHIP_CHARGE_BONUS, and where it holds 0x8000 plays movs r0,#0xbc; adds r0,#0xff, 0x1BB, at 0x0800D536-0x0800D53C; BN6: its chip use asks BN6_CHARGE_BONUS 0x08012C7C, which soulchips.c answers with BN4's bonus for a BN4 Soul, and plays movs r0,#0x87 at 0x08012848 for any bonus). Each engine's own sound of a charged chip; bn4_soul_aqua at t125 (AquaSoul's Bubbler charged), bn4_soul_metl at t250 (MetlSoul's AirHoc1)
